Ai + Agents: Model Context Protocol, Tool calling, Agentic workflows, Multi-model routing, OpenRouter, Claude Code, Protocol design. Ad Tech: Index Exchange, Magnite, PubMatic, OpenX, Xandr, TripleLift, Nexxen, Equativ, Media.net, Adverity. Shipping: Docker, Linux, Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Git, Browser automation.
